name: Pudens
title: Christian brother in Rome
summary: Pudens was a Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul's second letter to Timothy. He is mentioned together with Linus, Claudia, and other believing brothers as part of the church in Rome toward the end of Paul's life.

keyEvents.title: Greetings to Timothy
keyEvents.description: Pudens is mentioned by Paul as one of the believers in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy. This happened at a time when Paul was imprisoned and near death.

keyEvents.title: Part of the church in Rome
keyEvents.description: Pudens was part of the Christian community in Rome along with other believers such as Eubulus, Linus, and Claudia, representing the early church's growth in the capital of the Roman Empire.
